title.narrative: Strenghening Results-based M&E for better migration management

description.narrative: This task will enable the Government of Tajikistan in improving the labor and migration management practices in Tajikistan. Labor migration and associated remittances contribute significantly to economic growth and poverty reduction (making Tajistan top in the world with over 50% of the GDP in remittances) as well as provides over a million of labor migrants (30% of active labor force) and their households (over 50%) with an important social protection mechanism. The country has developed and is in the process of adopting a new Legal framework to manage labor migration as well as a corresponding Labor migration strategy and an Action plan. The Bank was instrumental in this undertaking. As a result, the government has revitalized the work of the Interministerial migration commission as well as created an autonomous Migration Agency with a mandate to oversee and provide overall guidance and policy framework to improve labor migration management system. In this context, an IDF supported results-based M&E will help the new Agency fulfill this mandate effectively. TF098648 The key development objective of the IDF is to develop and strengthen the capacity of the Government of Tajikistan and a newly created Migration Agency under the Government in monitoring and evaluation of migration-related policies and interventions (both government and donor). Specifically, this will contribute to the overall improvement of national planning and decision making in the area of labor migration management. Secondary objective of the IDF is to help create an operational results-based M&E system based on (i) solid data flows; (ii) sustainable capacity building activities; (iii) regional dialogue and (iv) supporting implementation of short and medium term actions aimed at improving labor management systems.
